speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. To narrow this down, does the pain localize specifically to the medial (inner) side of the knee, and has it ever felt like it "gave way" or buckled during those twisting motions? Also, is there any visible swelling or warmth in that area right now?

speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Medial Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome (MPFP)
